description:
Every Sunday, Hongju and Cheong get together to play board games.
That day, Hongju showed up with a brand new game in hand.
“Ooh, this looks fun. Easy games are always the most fun.”
The two of them started playing, buzzing with excitement.
“…It says to suck your finger like a lollipop?”
But then… things started to get weird.
[Massage the other person’s bum five times]
[Suck the finger of the person in front of you like a lollipop]
That’s when Hongju finally realised—
the Octopus Game she brought… was actually an R-rated board game.
She tried to stop the game, but—
“So you’re backing out? That means you’re the one breaking the pact, yeah?”
“Who said I’m backing out? It’s just sucking a finger, not a big deal.”
Falling right into Cheong’s provocation, Hongju decided to keep going.
“Read the final mission out loud yourself.”
